name: simulate_t_wave_alternans
mechanism: Simulates T-wave alternans by applying a beat-to-beat alternating amplitude modulation to the T-wave in severe cases.

name: composite_gaussian_t_wave
mechanism: Replaces a single Gaussian with a composite of two Gaussian waves to generate a broad, asymmetric T-wave morphology for LQT1 without engulfing the QRS complex.
code_snippet: lead_II += gaussian_wave(t, beat_t + center_t1, sigma_t1, amp_II * 0.6); lead_II += gaussian_wave(t, beat_t + center_t2, sigma_t2, amp_II)

name: decoupled_gaussian_component_amplitudes
mechanism: Assigning independent amplitude parameters to individual Gaussian components of a composite wave prevents unnatural additive summation and improves morphological realism.

name: fractional_qt_twave_timing
mechanism: Positions T-wave Gaussian centers using proportional fractions of the QT interval relative to QRS onset instead of fixed backward offsets from the end of the T-wave.

name: composite_gaussian_twave_morphology
mechanism: Replaces a single excessively wide Gaussian with a composite of two Gaussians (an early broad component and a narrower main peak) to generate a realistic, broad-based, asymmetric T-wave for LQT1.
code_snippet: lead_II += gaussian_wave(t, beat_t + center_t1, sigma_t1, amp_II * 0.5) lead_II += gaussian_wave(t, beat_t + center_t2, sigma_t2, amp_II * 0.8)

name: model_lqt1_single_broad_gaussian
mechanism: Replaces a composite two-Gaussian T-wave model with a single, exceptionally broad Gaussian to accurately simulate the symmetrical, broad-based morphology characteristic of LQT1.
code_snippet: sigma_t = np.random.uniform(0.07, 0.11); center_t = qrs_onset + qt * 0.55; lead_II += gaussian_wave(t, beat_t + center_t, sigma_t, amp_II)
